title: Composition of smooth exchange in finite comparison coordinates
statement: In [def-pur-conventions], the specified exchange of [def-pur-orientation-refinement-comparisons] for two composable Cartesian squares of pure-d-dimensional smooth finite-type maps satisfies pasting with the pro-etale pullback compositor. Changing equal top or base arrows changes only the pullback source identification.

proof.text: Use ordinary dualizing exchange pasting, then the derived site-comparison composition law. Naturality moves the first exchange across the second comparison, giving exactly the specified pro-etale composite.
Equality elimination proves the arrow-congruence formula.
